envelope.text: and `default_string_array(&[&str])`; neither exists here, so pass the array

why:
builds an array default from any `IntoIterator<Item = T>`. Ours takes the value directly, and an array value is a `heapless::Vec` bounded by `MAX_ARRAY_LEN`; collecting an unbounded iterator into a fixed capacity has to fail somewhere, which is what `ParameterVariant::try_to_parameter_value` reports (issue 0323). No allocator.

issue 1637 (2026-10-05) — ENVELOPE WRITTEN where a porting user reads it: rclrs's convenience setter has no counterpart to hang a comment on, so the envelope is on the one setter there is, `ParameterBuilder::default`, whose rustdoc now names both absent setters, the `heapless` bounds, and the refusal (not truncation) of an over-capacity value.
